Classic Christmas Eve Sugar Cookies

Served at: Christmas Eve

About 3-4 dozen cookies (depending on size)Prep 30 min (plus 1-2 hours chilling)Cook 8-10 min per batch

These delightful cut-out sugar cookies are a quintessential part of Christmas Eve celebrations, perfect for leaving out for Santa Claus or sharing with loved ones. Their simple, sweet flavor and versatile nature make them ideal for decorating with festive icing and sprinkles, adding a touch of homemade magic to the holiday.

Ingredients

  • 2 3/4 cups (330g) all-purpose flour
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1 cup (226g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1 1/2 cups (300g) granulated sugar
  • 1 large egg
  • 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
  • For Royal Icing (optional):
  • 4 cups (480g) powdered sugar, sifted
  • 3 tablespoons (45ml) milk or water
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Food coloring (optional)

Method

  1. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
  2. In a large bowl, using an electric mixer, cream together the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy, about 2-3 minutes.
  3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until well combined.
  4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing on low speed until just combined. Do not overmix.
  5. Divide the dough in half, flatten each half into a disk, wrap tightly in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1-2 hours, or until firm.
  6. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
  7. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one disk of chilled dough to about 1/4-inch (6mm) thickness. Use your favorite Christmas cookie cutters to cut out shapes.
  8. Carefully transfer the cut-out cookies to the prepared baking sheets, leaving about 1 inch (2.5cm) between them.
  9. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden. The centers should still be soft.
  10. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
  11. Once completely cooled, prepare the royal icing if desired: Whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add food coloring as desired. Decorate cookies as you wish.

Tips

  • Do not skip chilling the dough; it helps prevent the cookies from spreading too much during baking and makes them easier to handle.
  • For perfectly shaped cookies, re-roll dough scraps only once or twice, as overworking the dough can make them tough.
  • Store undecorated cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to a week, or freeze for up to 3 months.
